topic: Ice Age art: the Lion-man, the Venus of Willendorf, Altamira and Chauvet
why this topic: Prehistoric art – the oldest art there is – had no article: Altamira, Chauvet, the Venus of Willendorf and the Lion-man were asked nowhere (Lascaux only as a chance find); placed in Sculpture & Photography, a less crowded sub than Painting.

topic: Ice ages and climate swings: Milanković cycles, Younger Dryas, Snowball Earth, Little Ice Age
why this topic: Weather & Climate (the domain's smallest sub) covered winds, clouds and records but nothing on how Earth's climate itself has changed – ice ages, their orbital pacemaker and the Little Ice Age were missing entirely.

topic: German sayings of luck and bad luck: Schwein haben, Daumen drücken, toi toi toi, Pechvogel
why this topic: Idioms & Sayings is the domain's smallest sub, and the most common German luck idioms (Schwein haben, Daumen drücken, toi toi toi, Pechvogel) were not explained anywhere in the bank.

topic: National personifications: Marianne, Uncle Sam, John Bull and the Deutscher Michel
why this topic: Peoples, Flags & Emblems (one of the two smallest subs) had flags, anthems and coats of arms but none of the famous human emblems of nations – Marianne, Uncle Sam, John Bull and the Deutscher Michel were never asked.
